keywords: Work Experience 2.Basic Skills for Working Life 3.Understanding the Industry and Company 4.Career Choice
educationalGoal: Through work experience, students will understand what it means to work and become aware of the level of basic social skills and specialized knowledge required to work in a company. Students will recognize the difference between their image of the industry and company before the work experience and deepen their understanding of the industry and company.
advice: [Pre-Lecture] (1st Session) ① What is an internship (work experience)? Understand the significance of an internship by what experiences and gains you can gain from participating. ② Self-evaluate your current basic work skills and, based on the results, set specific goals for improving those skills during your internship. ③ Deepen your understanding of major industries and companies and conduct research on the company where you will be participating in your internship. [Internship] (2nd-14th Session) ① Based on your own company research, take action to clarify any questions or concerns you may have. ② Take concrete action to achieve your basic skills and summarize your work experience in a daily report. [Post-Lecture] (15th Session) ① Organize and summarize what you learned and realized during the work experience. ② Based on the evaluation results from the company representative, develop a plan to improve your basic skills during your future university life.
requiredKnowledge: By participating in job hunting guidance sessions and broadening your academic knowledge in your field of expertise, you will be able to imagine working in a variety of industries. It is also desirable that you have an understanding of the role of a company in society, basic management knowledge, and industries and sectors, which are necessary to promote fulfilling work at a company. It is also desirable that you have the minimum etiquette necessary for entering society.

activityGoals.body: Understand the significance of internships (work experience) and clarify your purpose for participating.
Understand basic skills for working adults and be able to self-evaluate and set goals.
You can conduct corporate research on the target company.
You can act with awareness of the basic skills you have set as your goals.
You will be able to plan how to improve and enhance your life as a university student.
Students will be able to plan in detail how they will acquire the knowledge in their future studies.

achievementLevels.ideal: Students will understand the significance of internships, be able to set their purpose for participating in internships from the perspective of both improving their basic working skills and confirming their own level of specialized knowledge, and be able to form their own career plan. Furthermore, they will be able to decide on a company to participate in based on their own career plan and conduct research on the industry and company that corresponds to that company. After understanding the basic working skills, they will be able to self-evaluate, set goals, and participate in work experience with an active attitude.
achievementLevels.standard: Students will be able to understand the significance of internships and set their own goals for participating. They will be able to decide on a company to participate in and conduct research on that company based on advice from their instructor or career counselor. They will be able to self-evaluate and set goals. They will be able to complete their work experience without any problems by following instructions from company representatives. They will be able to complete their work experience while keeping in mind the goals they have set for themselves. After completing their work experience, they will be able to consider their future study plans based on the evaluations from company representatives.

lessons.assignments: ・Research "internships" ・Look back on your past and t hink about why you chose your department ・Understand your current situ ation, identify the skills you want to improve during your i nternship, and create a "goal setting sheet" ・Research the company where y ou will be interning ・Conduct a self-analysis base d on lectures

lessons.content: ・Perform work experience at a company. *The work experience must consist of at least fi ve working days (35 hours) (7 hours per day). ・On the first day of work experience, explain t he "Goal Setting" and "Evaluation Sheet" you bro ught with you to the company representative, gai n their understanding of your goals, and request an evaluation. ・During the work experience period, you will fi ll out a daily report.

lessons.content: (Post-lecture) - Through the lecture, students will understand their own situation after the internship and how to prepare for future job hunting. - Based on the "Daily Report," "Goal Setting and Evaluation Sheet," and "Internship Report" they prepared in advance, students will complete ind ividual work, compile their results into a works heet, and submit it after class.
lessons.assignments: - Review the evaluations from company representatives and wr ite an "internship report" to think about your future univer sity life. - Reflect on your lectures and work experience, consider you r career plan, and clarify you r vision for the future.
